# Illustrations, batch 3: D14 to D19

Six more, same vocabulary. Tokens only, muted derived by the existing swap table. No new
colours this time.

---

---

## Notes

**D14 is the only one with an empty chair in it.** The bonus is on the table, the cousin's
fee is the thing nobody said, and the empty seat is that silence. It is the most abstract
drawing in the set so far, and it may not read. If it doesn't, replace it with the bonus
alone: a slip and a stack.

**D15's box is vermilion inside, which is what jewellery boxes are.** That is the only use
of vermilion in this batch other than D18's clock hand and D19's broken roof line.

**D16's seedling is bone, not teal.** Teal means "went up" everywhere else, so a teal
seedling recommended investing before the player read the options, the same error the
coloured option cards made. The marigold seed head stays: the seed is the money going in.

**D16 is a seedling, and the empty pots behind it are the months not yet planted.** This is
the one place where a metaphor is doing the work rather than an object. It is also the
decision the whole product exists for, so it is worth being sure it earns the exception.

**D18's clock reads about five past one, with the minute hand vermilion.** A clock nearly
out of time would be more dramatic and less true: the player has three weeks, not three
minutes.

Eleven decisions still have none after this: D20 to D30.
